definition: While there is an argument that artificial intelligence (AI) will improve access to Sikh teachings, philosophy, and history, there are skeptics who believe the information provided may not be accurate.
details: Furthermore, there are concerns regarding AI-generated images of Sikh personalities and their potential to offend members of the Sikh community. Usage of AI for Sikh purposes has been officially banned by the Akal Takht since late December 2025. Sikhs commonly use AI to access gurbani translation and learning, media generation, and virtual sangats, however concerns exist regarding simplification, commodification, accuracy,
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Sikhism and artificial intelligence.
